visualPitch: Photorealistic night football stadiums and empty pitch atmospheres — deep turf green, floodlight gold and white, clay/terracotta accents, cinematic live-action sports photography (not illustration)

style.aesthetic: photorealistic cinematic still, real-world stadium materials and lighting, high-end live-action sports production design, physically based rendering look, documentary-sharp architecture photography of football grounds at night, subtle volumetric floodlight haze, believable turf paint and concrete, earnest legacy mood (not meme, not grimdark)
